verdict.rationale: Cubic is a SaaS AI code-review platform that processes customer code, so data region or residency choice is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, data residency, or choosing a data location. The closest items cover cubic.yaml configuration and role-based access control, which are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
